input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: Searches for "insurance", "coverage/policy/certificate" and "workers compensation" returned nothing, and a full read of the miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13-30) and definitions confirms the Agreement contains no insurance obligation at all. TrueLink hosts the Client web site and transmits/stores borrower credit data, so the absence of any cover is walk-away territory under the rule. We insert a single short clause at the preferred level (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Client data is processed, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback offered in the comment. The conditional cyber element is drafted to reach all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Client rather than the named Client Content/Credit Data examples.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance clause (CGL, E&O, cyber, workers' comp, certificates)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance clause even though TrueLink hosts our site and processes borrower credit data, so we added our standard coverage requirements with certificates on request. We can fall back to E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 if needed.

ops.text: INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where TrueLink processes any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Client, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. TrueLink shall provide certificates of insurance to Client on request.
